test_title: PYST 19: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option with the correct spelling to substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

It was a __priviledge__ to meet the finance minister of the country last week.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **privilege**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"priviledge"** is incorrectly spelled.
 
• **​"Privilege"** refers to a special right, advantage, or immunity granted or available only to a particular person or group. (विशेषाधिकार)
 
 
• **Example:** It was a **privilege **to meet the finance minister of the country last week.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained:

 
• **Privledge**: This is an incorrect spelling and does not have a meaning.
 
• **Previledge**: This is another incorrect spelling and does not have a meaning.
 
• **Privilage**: This is also an incorrect spelling and does not have a meaning.
